notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
